limitations: Native plan-link navigation uses synthetic CLI-prepared fixtures; desktop link creation, desktop link saving and dirty-target-tab interaction were not exercised.

Native theme captures verify neutral Glass chrome and saved reduced-effects settings. Flat docked chrome does not prove a visual difference between effects modes.
